name: Prague Gateway DC
notes: DCD reports CRA received a building permit and began construction in the Zbraslav-Jiloviste area; first 700-rack building targeted for end-2027; full two-story site planned at 26 MW, 2,000 racks, 4,000 sqm IT area.

name: T-Mobile DC7 Prague expansion
notes: Expansion added four data halls, 1,400 sqm and 3 MW, taking the facility to about 10 MW total; Baxtel notes the expansion was completed in 2025.

name: TTC Teleport DC2
notes: Datacenters.com lists the Prague 10-Malesice facility at Sazecska 595/10 with access to 10 MW; Uptime Institute award page identifies TTC DC2 in Praha as a major TTC data centre.

name: CE Colo DC7
notes: CE Colo official DC7 page describes a Prague site with 25,000 sqm land, 2,800 sqm IT infrastructure and 9,000 sqm total premises. DataCenterMap lists the facility at K Perovne 1616/2 in Prague.

name: VSHosting ServerPark
notes: VSHosting official site says it built and operates its own data centre on the outskirts of Prague, opened in 2015, using green energy and reporting 100% uptime since opening.

name: Seznam.cz Nagoya
notes: Seznam.cz official announcement says Nagoja opened in Benatky nad Jizerou and that Seznam.cz had two owned data centers, Kokura and Nagoja, with target output of 2x3 MW; Datacenters.com lists Nagoja in Central Bohemian Region with 3 MW power.

name: SPCSS Zeleneč
notes: SPCSS official page identifies DC Zeleneč as a modern Tier III-level data centre for critical infrastructure; DataCenterMap specs list 3 MW fully built-out power and 332 sqm whitespace in Zeleneč v Čechách.

name: WEDOS DC1 Bunker
notes: WEDOS official locations page states DC1 Bunker is the company's first datacentre in Hluboka nad Vltavou, established in 2010 in a former civil defence shelter and upgraded with more than CZK 20 million invested.

name: WEDOS DC2 Underground
notes: WEDOS official locations page describes DC2 Underground in Hluboka nad Vltavou, using oil bath and water cooling and waste-heat reuse for the building, parking lot and planned swimming-pool heating.

name: FORPSI Datacenter Ktiš
notes: FORPSI official site says the Ktis data center has capacity for more than 5,000 servers and is owned by the company; Aruba's official page and DataCenterMap specs report 1 MW power for the Ktis facility.

name: Host-Telecom Data Center
notes: Host-Telecom official site and contacts list the data center at Pod Rafandou 906, Veseli nad Luznici; DataCenterMap describes the facility as Tier III-designed with redundant power sources and advanced cooling.

name: TCP Data Center Písek
notes: DataCenterMap lists TCP Data Center at Vladislavova 250 in Pisek with Tier 3 service, up to 20 kW per rack and 40 Gb backbone; CzechTrade exporter profile lists rackhousing, dedicated server and virtual data center services for Technologicke centrum Pisek at the same address.

name: Škoda Group Data Center
notes: Škoda Group official reference states it operates a modern, large-capacity, highly available and fully secured data center running its own and client servers across multiple operating platforms and applications.

name: ATICOM data center / server farm
notes: ATICOM official site describes a data center/server farm on a backbone optical network with backed-up power, 24-hour diesel generator, camera system and guaranteed service; EDB and Info-Vary provide Karlovy Vary business-location context.

name: Datové centrum Ústeckého kraje / Rondel
notes: DCUK official site lists the Ústí nad Labem public data center organization and its Rondel operating site at Masarykova 750/316; E15 reported the EU-supported Rondel data center project during its development.

Search found SuperNetwork headquartered in Liberec offering managed/dedicated servers and server housing, plus a 2013 speculative local server-farm idea, but no current verified public data-center facility or active project in Liberec division.

name: O2 Data Centre Hradec Králové
notes: DataCenterMap lists O2 Hradec Kralove at Akademika Bedrny 365/10 with Tier III housing services and 24/7 access; Uptime Institute has a Tier achievement page for Telefonica Czech Republic HC TKB Hradec Kralove.

name: ČD-Telematika Pardubice
notes: DataCenterMap lists ČD-Telematika Pardubice at Hlavacova 205, 530 02 Pardubice; Data Center Platform independently lists the same Pardubice facility for CD-Telematics.

name: CRA Pardubice regional data center
notes: CRA official data-centres page says regional data centres are available in Brno, Zlin, Pardubice, Ostrava and Luzice; Datacenters.com lists one CRA data center in the Pardubice Region market.

name: Data Center Jihlava
notes: Official DC Jihlava page places the facility at Srazna 21 in Jihlava and describes four data rooms with 316 racks, two 1,250 kVA transformers and N+1 cooling; DataCenterMap lists the facility at 2 MW.
